readerCopy.summary: A difficult story is told with enough clarity to move people without exploiting the person at its center.
readerCopy.body: A difficult story is told with enough clarity to move people without exploiting the person at its center. Testimony, art, reporting, or a private conversation carries the emotional truth while keeping dates, names, and responsibilities intact. Mercury gives the account structure, while Neptune allows grief, imagination, and compassion to remain present inside it. Under the trine, fact and feeling support each other instead of forcing the audience to choose one. The story can inspire a response because its emotional force does not depend on blurring what actually happened.
